points.point: Home Depot completed its annual recoverability assessment of indefinite-lived intangible assets during the third quarter of fiscal 2026 and recognized no impairment losses.
points.quote: During the third quarter of fiscal 2026, we completed our annual assessment of the recoverability of our indefinite-lived intangible assets based on quantitative factors and concluded that no impairment losses should be recognized.

points.point: The company posted $542 million in cash collateral related to derivative instruments under collateral security arrangements as of November 1, 2026.
points.quote: The cash collateral posted by the Company related to derivative instruments under our collateral security arrangements was $ 542 million and $ 459 million as of November 1, 2026 and February 1, 2026, respectively, which was recorded in other current assets on our consolidated balance sheets.

points.point: Management expects that litigation arising in the normal course of business will not have a material adverse effect on the company's financial condition or results.
points.quote: In management’s opinion, any such litigation is not expected to have a material adverse effect on our consolidated financial condition, results of operations, or cash flows.
